_comment: Hook configuration for the claude-code-sdlc plugin.
Claude Code loads this automatically when the plugin is installed.
NEVER copy its contents into settings.json — plugin hooks auto-load, and
duplicating them there makes every hook fire twice.
Every handler is invoked through hooks/lib/run-hook.js. There is no inline
bootstrap in any command string: the wrapper is where the fail-open
contract, the Node version gate and the runtime kill switches live, so a
hook that bypassed it would bypass all of them. CI enforces this.
No hook here blocks. Every one exits 0 whatever happens; blocking guards
SDLC_DISABLED_HOOKS is a comma-separated id list; SDLC_HOOK_PROFILE is
minimal | standard | strict (invalid values fall back to standard).

hooks.description: Injects current feature, branch, wave and slice from the scratchpad so a resumed or compacted session re-enters the autonomous loop at the right point. Also reports memory-layer version drift.
Records that a file was read, so the PreToolUse half can tell a fresh edit from one made against stale, pre-compaction memory.
Records each edited path so the Stop hook can run format and typecheck once per response instead of once per edit.
Refuses commits on main, bulk staging, AI attribution, non-conventional messages and unrequested pushes.
Refuses a whole-file Write that would gut a curated document.
Refuses an edit to a file not read this session.
Refuses edits that weaken quality configuration or silence type and lint checks.
Refuses a parallel-wave subagent writing the scratchpad, changelog or instinct store; the orchestrator owns all three.
Runs the project's declared format and typecheck commands once over everything edited this response. No-ops visibly when the project declares no such command.
Checks the shape of a changelog entry written this response, and that it is not a duplicate under today.
